title_th: รูปสามเหลี่ยม
story_theme_en: A triangle has two angles measuring 45 degrees and 65 degrees. What is the size of the third angle, and what type of triangle is it (acute, right, or obtuse)?
helper_tip: The sum of angles in a triangle = 180°
hint_th: ผลรวมมุมในรูปสามเหลี่ยม = 180°
think_story_en: Sum of angles in a triangle = 180 degrees. Third angle = 180 - 45 - 65 = 70 degrees. All angles are less than 90 degrees, so it is an acute triangle.
